title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_181.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a doctrine of vicarious atonement grounded in his 2-3/74 mystical experience, arguing that Christ (Zebra) as a Cosmic Christ interpenetrates the universe and has abolished the age of nemesis (deterministic punishment). He finds textual validation of this theology encoded in his novel about Jason Taverner's trial, seeing the supernatural verdict of innocence as both theological proclamation and literary crystallization of Christ's salvific return.
key_claims: Zebra, the entity PKD experienced in 2-74, is the Cosmic Christ (also identifiable with Dionysos), not previously manifested in 2000 years, returning to work invisibly behind world history.
Christ does not and cannot possess a humanoid body after resurrection; instead, as Pantocrator, Christ is ubique (omnipresent), interpenetrating the entire universe.

The trial of Jason Taverner represents the Great Assize (Final Judgment), where the verdict of innocence supersedes the 'serious old king's' justice, enacting vicarious atonement through the 'pure, innocent, spotless son' standing in judgment for humanity.
God's grace flows from divine love (not merit), suspending punishment and restoring humanity to primordial innocence through an act of absolution/exculpation rather than judicial reward.
The Age of Guilt (characterized by suffering, enslavement, crucifixion) is ending; the Age of Innocence is beginning as Form II (the illusory material world) is annexed to Form I (true reality/God).

The Kerygma (gospel proclamation) about Christ's death and resurrection was encoded steganographically in PKD's novel 'Tears,' providing textual verification of his visionary experience of Rome cAD45.
recurring_concepts: Age of Innocence vs. Age of Guilt
people_entities: Paul (Apostle, referenced on grace vs. law)
Parmenides (pre-Socratic philosopher, vindicated by PKD's Rome vision)
Jason Taverner (fictional character from PKD's works, trial as atonement metaphor)
texts_works: Scanner Darkly (PKD novel, referenced for schema of punishment)
Precious Artifact (PKD story, referenced for 3-layer reality schema)
Bible / Acts (World of Acts, Rome cAD45)
autobiographical: The 2-74/3-74 mystical experience where PKD encountered Zebra and received the gift of innocence
Breaking of 'astral determinism' occurring during the 3-74 experience
Vision of Rome cAD45 during the experience
Hearing an AI voice in 3-74 that PKD expects to hear again at death
27 years of writing as unconscious preparation for announcing the transition to the Age of Innocence
Fear for the safety of 'Tears' (his novel), suggesting deep personal investment in its theological truth
theological_motifs: Vicarious Atonement (Christ standing in judgment for humanity)
Christology: Cosmic Christ vs. incarnate Christ
Justification and Grace (divine mercy overriding merit-based justice)
Salvation as suspension of punishment and restoration of innocence
First and Second Advent (ongoing, hidden Christological intervention)
The Hidden Church (the 'true hidden Xtian church' that knows of Zebra's presence)
Gnosticism (emphasis on hidden knowledge and reality behind false appearance)
Transubstantiation (world invisibly becoming transubstantiated as Form I annexes Form II)
Divine Love vs. Justice (love triumphs in the trial verdict)
Free Gift of Grace (unearned, undeserved, flowing from God's love)
literary_self_ref: Jason Taverner's trial in 'Tears' as theological enactment of vicarious atonement
The schema in 'Scanner Darkly' ('they played and were punished far too much') as the precise formula Christ is abolishing through grace
The three-layer reality schema in 'Precious Artifact' mirroring PKD's Form I / Form II cosmology
Buckman's grief-turned-love in 'Tears' as the transformation from justice to mercy in the judicial verdict
The policeman crying 'happy' (Taverner) as intuitive placement of the supernatural entering Form II
The encoded Kerygma in 'Tears' as a complete dramatization (analog) of the 3-74 vision and its theological meaning
symbols_images: The trial / Great Assize (judgment transformed into acquittal)
The 'spotless son' (innocent victim standing in place of judgment)
Rome cAD45 (actualization of apostolic kerygma in vision)
The Black Iron Prison / BIP (oppressive system ending)
The Palm Tree Garden (restoration to primordial innocence)
The Roman prison / age of guilt (what is ending)
Ferocious dogs (desperation from which Form I saves)
The polyform Savior (incarnate rescue in Form II)
The serious white-haired old king (YHWH enacting justice, overruled by new covenant)
tensions: Uncertainty whether Zebra's presence is genuinely new (unprecedented in 2000 years) or an eternal reality finally manifest to PKD.
Contradiction between God's love being infinite and the apparent arbitrariness of grace-selection (some saved, others not, basis obscure).
Tension between intellectual/moral acuity as a salvific criterion versus pure grace independent of human merit.
Ambiguity about whether PKD's 27 years of writing was conscious prophecy or unconscious preparation, and how authorial intent relates to encoded theology.
Question of whether the Paraclete (Holy Spirit) enters human consciousness externally or emerges from it, and whether PKD's experience is individual or collective.
Unresolved logic of divine selection: 'we can't figure out God's basis of selection' despite the claim that 'some plan, purpose or pattern is involved.'
evidence_quotes: Of course Zebra is the Cosmic Christ. The Cosmic Christ certainly doesn't + wouldn't have a human or humanoid body, now, would he? He is interpenetrating the universe - just as I saw.

Gee - the trial of Jason Taverner = the dies Irie! + the verdict isn't what the serious white haired old king decrees, because this trial, which is the great assize, is supernaturally made into a trial of "the pure, innocent, spotless son who stands in the place of judgement for us, where by there is a verdict of innocent + we are saved"!
In a sense the Kerygma is: a suspension of punishment (+ a restoration of innocence). (The gift of innocence. Love + assistance + rescue is not a judicial matter.

The age of the curse (Tears, suffering + enslavement + crucifixion + punishment) is ending; joy, freedom, mercy + innocence + exculpation is beginning... as Form II is rendered irreal by annexation to Form I.

So our world is invisibly being transubstantiated, as the BIP + its power is ended. I experienced this in the breaking of the "Astral determinism" over, the nemesis which was beginning to arrive in 3-74, following the correct schema in "Scanner."
uncertainty_flags: Whether 'Tears' refers to 'Tears of Nahum' or another PKD work; the title is ambiguous in the text.
The identity of 'Little Boy Peter' and the TV drama PKD mentions—unclear whether this is a specific broadcast or a fictional reference.
The precise relationship between Dionysos and Christ in PKD's typology (are they the same entity or parallel manifestations?).
Whether the 'serious white-haired old king' in the trial verdict represents YHWH or a Demiurgic false god, given PKD's gnostic inclinations.
Ambiguity of 'ubique' (omnipresent)—PKD appears to be inventing or misremembering Latin usage here; the correct form might be 'ubiquitous.'
Unclear what 'Rome cAD45' refers to specifically—the exact apostolic event or a symbolic vision of the Age of Acts.
The 'steganographic Kerygma' claim requires verification—whether Dick consciously encoded this material in 'Tears' or discovered it retrospectively.

raw_text: writing. the world we see is not real. There is another, different real world behind it (a 3layer schema as in "Precious Artifact"). (78) I need no proof of the Kerygma encoded in "Tears" - I got that in 2-74/3-74. We are not able to identify Zebra (Christ/Dionysos). My guess that that which I saw + called Zebra had not (just as I guessed by the total lack of previous reports of such an experience as mine in 2000 years) been previously here. But had returned - otherwise, why the message in "Tears"? You do - well, it's less likely you'd smuggle in an encoded message about a static long term stable condition than re an event (a current one). The message in "Tears" was news that something had happened, + that happening was his return. Amazed at what I saw I named it Zebra, not knowing what or who it was. I presume he now (still) invisibly works behind the scenes of world history as it unfolds, but the true hidden Xtian church knows. I, ahem, helped tell them. The age of the curse (Tears, suffering + enslavement + crucifixion + punishment) is ending; joy, freedom, mercy + innocence + exculpation is beginning... as Form II is rendered irreal by annexation to Form I. That in a very real sense the world is coming to an end - which justifies my grand them in 27 years of writing: this realization is what I've been preparing people for (without my knowing it - in a sense I was looking ahead), in being annexed to Form I we are annexed to God (Corpus Christi). (79) So our world is invisibly being transubstantiated, as the BIP + its power is ended. I experienced this in the breaking of the "Astral determinism" over, the nemesis which was beginning to arrive in 3-74, following the correct schema in "Scanner." It is precisely that schema ("they played, + were punished far too much") which Christ is abolishing (we know this as "salvation" - saving us from hell - not a bad description!) (i.e. what I call "Nemesis" = hell.) (Just as Jason Taverner was declared innocent; i.e. not punished; i.e. not sent to hell; i.e. saved by divine grace.) (The salvific power of God; Love expressed judicially - i.e. justification.) Gee - the trial of Jason Taverner = the dies Irie! + the verdict isn't what the serious white haired old king decrees, because this trial, which is the great assize, is supernaturally made into a trial of "the pure, innocent, spotless son who stands in the place of judgement for us, where by there is a verdict of innocent + we are saved"! Viewed this way I can understand the "vicarious atonement + perfect sacrifice" theme for the first time. Fascinating that I should name the titular policeman who cries "happy" without realizing it's the supernatural enters right there. (80) Of course Zebra is the Cosmic Christ. The Cosmic Christ certainly doesn't + wouldn't have a human or humanoid body, now, would he? He is interpenetrating the universe - just as I saw. This realization is important. Also, in addition to the external Cosmic Christ, the paraclete may have entered me enabling me to see true reality including the Cosmic Christ at work - so both forms of the deity were present. + the Holy Spirit put the material in "Tears" etc. Once Christ is resurrected + becomes Cosmic - Pantocrator - he isn't ever going to shrink back down to a mere human body - that's absurd, + I've missed that point. He will be ubique (sic). ---------- The TV drama tonight about the Little Boy Peter - the girl he saw was a polyform of the Savior sent to rescue him, an invasion of the Form II by I. She appeared to him at the low point in his life (transmute from the ferocious dogs) + then at the end reappeared + took him away, this is very much like the AI voice I heard in 3-74 + will hear again when I am dying, as was shown to me. The drama rekindled my memories + hence [helps]. ---------- The Age of Guilt giving way to the Age of Innocence (which I specify as happening) is precisely a return to + restoration of our primordial lost state. Odd that my system would collate with orthodoxy again, + again on a major point. (81) But all I am proclaiming is nothing more than that which the First Advent inaugurated (But which is deliberately concealed from us, the power of Darkness). I merely proclaim the truth, the real world hidden by the counterfeit world. In my writing I insist that we abolish false world + false memories (identities). The kingdom is already here but the dark powers, which are in control, blind us to it. Yet, beyond their blinding, is a secret: the Kingdom is camouflaged, as Zebra is - not just due to the powers of darkness. A riddle is put to us - a puzzle which we must solve. God allows this Satanic occlusion to serve as a problem for us to solve. (The "Balking" which I speck of viz: can we discern that epistemologically it isn't real + morally it isn't good?) Thus a judicial dividing of mankind is accomplished. It is more of a learning + evolving that a moral exercise, a being "good." Something closer to intellectual acuity is involved, or required. In a sense it is true that salvation is a free gift of grace unconnected to merit; it can't be "brought" by merit in a cause - + - effect way. That would be the old Law once again. Grace flows not from man's merit but God's love, God's decision is not compelled by what man has done good; conversely, God can justify (Give Grace anyhow) where there is a lack of merit. The disparity is filled in by God (without man deserving it in a strictly judicial sense). So Grace is not earned. (82) + no man can point to a deed or deeds + say "this is why salvation was bestowed." A criticism of unfairness (person A got it,, but B didn't, + both are equal in merit) is answered thusly: neither deserves it on merit; no merit is enough. When all is said + done God; Love remains. This shows up as illustrated in many parables. The concept of free gift (of Grace) must be comprehended - mercy above justice. Justice in the strict judicial sense would exclude too many people. (asa with the old Law as Paul explains.) The idea is, you are not entitled to demand salvation as a reward for your merit. The power of God's Love is Greater that the system of merit + reward. It is a titanic step forward in the relation in between God + man, in reconciling them. It is a way of miraculously restoring man to his lost innocent state - so to speak by [great] decree of absolution (exculpation). This fits "Tears" once again. The conception I have is that God loves man + assists him out of that love. Man cannot demand that love as his due, but he can count on it by faith. He would be completely wrong to think himself excluded from that love (+ hence from grace). Man's failings are finite + God's love is infinite. I really do have an "adoptionist" sense of one gaining God's approved (support) by certain decisive acts...which I see as one correctly solving intellectual/moral choice problems - i.e. going one way vs the alternative. (83) "+ gained from heaven a friend." I feel that God takes note + is interested. That, most of all, he understands (what other people can't + so is sympathetic (" he sees even the fallen sparrow"). In a sense I would even define God that way" "as the sentience in the cosmos which understand." But all this is not a way of saying man is a sinner (deficient in merits). What it says is, God's Love is for the desperate + the damned, not for the goody-goody, who you see all righteous. All the piety can't make it - God reaches down into the gutter, the people like in "Scanner." In a sense the Kerygma is: a suspension of punishment (+ a restoration of innocence). (The gift of innocence. Love + assistance + rescue is not a judicial matter. In "Tears" the serious old King's verdict (Justice) is death. But Buckman turns grief over death into love; so love triumphs - not over death - but over the judicial verdict of death - + Taverner goes free. Within this sequence, the culmination of the book, the essential miracle of the Not is disclosed: the holy mystery + victory of love issuing out of greif + turning a sentence of guilty into innocence. I simply do not see this as judicial. I see it as - a freeing man of the curse, a releasing him from his enslaved state. The court sat, the books were opened, + (84) what prevailed was a saving, overriding love. In a way, the problem is, we can't figure out God's basis of selection. Code ethics did not provide an index. Whim probably is not the answer; some plan, purpose or pattern is involved, but we're too dumb to discern it. It goes back to my concept of him posing us a problem to solve. Naturally we're not to develop a solution formula - that would defeat the purpose. In a nutshell, my book announces the ushering in of the age of man's (restored) innocence, which is to say, Christ Returned the final Kerygma. ---------- Voice:"What my book (secretly) teaches is what w3e must teach in order to be Xtians." Wow. ---------- That TV drama about the little boy shows how the Form I mystical, spiritual, salvific + sublime penetrates Form II at its most desperate point + [extrelates] the beleagered victim. --------- My perception of Rome cAD45 proves that Parmenides is right + our realor, Form II, does not really exist, except insofar as we give is assent. Time + causality always in which our brains store sequential information. This can be made the subsect of dysfunction. But the right exciter factors are required. (85) When you consider the clear + precise way that the authentic Xtian Kerygma is presented in "Tears" - then my 3-74 experience becomes only one part, a completing part, of the Miracle. I received the gift of innocence, the suspension of punishment, awareness of the presence of Christ - i.e. proof of the truth of the presence of Christ - i.e. proof of the truth of the proclamation buried in the actual dramatic context (not just encoded textually) of the novel. The serious white haired old King is perhaps YHWH, overruled by the new covanent of love issuing out of the age of grief (i.e. Tears) into the age of joy + innocence. The 3-74 experience without the encoded Kerygma in "Tears" is the full miracle. The encoded Kerygma is a full miracle. One is a verbal dramatizations + proclamation (analog) of the other. The two together are like the pleroma, Forms I + II combined (message + the reality that message describes). I wonder when I knew that book was true, it always was so important to me. I feared so much for its safety. No wonder in my 3-74 experience I saw Rome cAD45. The Kerygma proclaimed it: the Death + Resurrection of Christ! So when I ask. why did I see Rome cAD45 (World of Acts) - Look to the stegenographic Kerygma in "Tears"! Given the Kerygma, the vision of Rome cAD45 is airtight logical. There is a push-pull verification, when all is known (i.e. the encoded material discerned is clear). In toto, the magnitude of the revelation is beyond my capacity to grasp to see what I saw, to know what was told me!
